title: LowKey PvPPack
description: A lightweight PvP texture pack designed to improve visibility and gameplay. This pack hides the fishing rod bobber for a cleaner screen and enlarges ender pearls, making them easier to track during fights and clutch situations.
body:
# PvP Visibility Pack

This texture pack is designed for PvP players who want better visual clarity during fights.

## Features

* Hidden fishing rod bobber for a cleaner screen and less visual clutter.
* Enlarged ender pearls, making them easier to see and track in combat.
* Lightweight and simple changes focused purely on PvP.

## Why use this pack?

During intense PvP situations, every detail matters. By removing the fishing rod bobber and increasing the size of ender pearls, this pack helps improve awareness and visibility without changing the overall Minecraft look.

Perfect for competitive PvP, practice servers, and players who prefer a cleaner experience.
